stem:
Which of the following Countries is a land-locked country?
1. Afghanistan 2. Hungary
3. Malaysia 4. Switzerland
Choose the correct answer from the codes given below-Code :
expl: Afghanistan located in Asia is a landlocked country that borders Iran, Pakistan, India (Ladakh), China, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan. Hungary is another landlocked country that borders Austria, Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia, Romania, Ukraine and Slovak Republic. The border of Switzerland is surrounded by France, Italy, Austria, Liechtenstein and Germany. Thus, all the above three countries have no coastline while the border of Malaysia is connected with Thailand, Indonesia, Brunei and it also has an extensive coastline. Thus, option (d) is the correct answer.

stem: Which one of the following is not a landlocked country?
expl: Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan are fully landlocked countries while the north-western border of Uzbekistan stretches to the Aral Sea. Similarly, Baku the capital of Azerbaijan is located on the western shore of the Caspian Sea. So in context of this question, two of the above-mentioned options (a) and (d) seem to be correct. Aral Sea used to be a part of the former Soviet Union. The Soviet Union diverted rivers flowing into Aral Sea for various irrigation projects, as a result, it has mostly dried up and only 10% of its area is left. Caspian Sea is the world’s largest lake or sea, surrounded by land. Thus, the most appropriate answer according to the given facts should be option (d).

stem: Maginot Line exists between which countries?
expl: The Maginot Line was a massive line of fortifications built by France before the Second World War to stop a possible attack Germany. It was mainly a fixed defensive line built on France’s eastern border facing Germany (and partly towards Luxembourg).
